task: T29 consumer call logging (CC derivation + hidden logger)

derived_surface_texture.deviation: purely additive: an #include, the r29c_begin helper, and r29c_observe() calls at update/detach/attach. No original line removed; no control flow or lifecycle change.

derived_texture_view.deviation: additive hooks PLUS four behavior-preserving edits: (1) nDestroy body extracted verbatim into destroyNativeWindowImpl, (2) public nDestroy forwards to it, (3) nCreate calls that impl (same destroy-first order/count) and takes a diagnostic out-param to correlate old->new in one record, (4) the two OH ref/unref calls capture their EXISTING int32 return into ref_rc/unref_rc. Call count/order and the original SetLongField strategy are unchanged.

logger_api.visibility: R29_HIDDEN (hidden); extern "C" for the C++ derived TUs; prefix r29c_ keeps it an independent per-DSO logger with no clash against the cpu observe29.c

observe_properties.values_only: no address-valued field is ever dereferenced by the logger
observe_properties.oh_correlation: OH = the PRODUCER NativeWindow (state->nativeWindow, write-once) or the TextureView OH window — NOT the image
observe_properties.detached: set ONLY by a successful attach(false)/detach(true); update/invalid/failed paths leave it UNKNOWN (no racy non-atomic read)
observe_properties.ref_unref_independent: producer ref/unref each record called/rc_valid/rc; the real int32 return is captured (rc_valid=1); never substituted for raw_rc/public_rc
observe_properties.self_caller: self = the enclosing function address (locatable, non-zero); caller = __builtin_return_address(0) (0 = unknown). surface update/detach/attach and TextureView nCreate record their JNI entry; the producer-destroy record's self is the EXTRACTED HELPER &destroyNativeWindowImpl (the public nDestroy forwards to it and emits no record of its own), NOT the JNI entry TextureView_nDestroyNativeWindow
observe_properties.sink: private CLOEXEC dup of fd2, verified S_IFREG with saved dev/ino re-checked before every eligible write; a pipe/socket/identity-drift disables observation (coverage UNKNOWN), never falls back; one write per record, no retry, short/failed write -> loss + disable; SIGPIPE disposition unchanged

invocation_args.--source-root: <MAIN repo root with the real OH/JNI seam>

method_comparison.status: Final integrated logger and unchanged method TUs: 40 behavior comparisons, 40 independent processes and three active Rust selectors PASS (0 ignored).

R29-C04.detail: failure = (existing_exception_branch || rc || raw_rc) does NOT count a non-zero valid ref_rc/unref_rc as error; after two successes, two producer records whose only failure signal is unref_rc=-31 (rc=0, raw_rc=0) are mis-lane'd as success, share the 2-success lane, and can be dropped
R29-C04.derived_note: the derived TUs already record independent ref_rc/unref_rc with rc_valid=1; once the classification includes a non-zero valid ref/unref rc, those records land in the error lane correctly -- no derived change needed
R29-C04.test_caveat: test/test_observe29c.c refunref mode asserts the PRE-FIX behavior (non-zero ref_rc does NOT flip the lane); the 14-mode PASS therefore does NOT represent the final/correct error budget for ref/unref
R29-C04.ownership: Codex derives the minimal failure-classification fix (+ real negative cases) from observe29c.c ddd684fb in its own tree and delivers the official replacement logger + test; CC keeps the four sources and test unchanged; root selects/unifies the single FINAL logger
R29-C04.resolution: Valid called nonzero ref/unref results now select independent diagnostic error quota. Original negative evidence and old incorrect test assertion retained in budget-fix package; corrected 14 modes plus 2 budget regressions independently replayed.
